summary: Iteration 133 - Frontend testing for 4 requested features in MoltBot Canvas Editor: (1) Multi-select checkboxes in Layers Panel, (2) Alignment Toolbar with selection count, (3) Export/Import with 3 template buttons, (4) Mobile inspector toggle and Live sync toggle. All features PASS. Navigation between /moltbot, /customers, /operations works without crash/freeze.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 requested features verified working in MoltBot Canvas Editor (/moltbot page). Multi-select via checkboxes in LayersPanel works, AlignmentToolbar shows selection count and applies styles to group, ExportImportDialog has 3 template buttons that inject blocks correctly, mobile inspector toggle and live sync toggle both functional.

multi_select_layers_panel.details: Found 12 multi-select checkboxes in layers panel. Clicking multiple checkboxes selects multiple items.

alignment_toolbar_selection_count.details: Alignment toolbar shows 'تحديد متعدد: 2' when 2 items selected. All alignment buttons (right, center, left, stretch, padding+/-, gap) present and clickable.

export_import_templates.details: Export/Import menu contains template section with 3 template buttons: KPI Dashboard, Customers List, Reports. Clicking template injects blocks into editor.

mobile_inspector_toggle.details: Mobile inspector toggle button visible on mobile viewport (390x844). Button text toggles between 'إظهار اللوحة' and 'إخفاء اللوحة'. Right panel has 'mobile-open' class when opened.

live_sync_toggle.details: Live sync toggle button found with text 'معاينة حية'. Clicking toggles active state (adds 'active' class).

navigation_no_crash.details: Navigation between /moltbot, /customers, /operations works without crash or freeze. All pages load correctly and return to /moltbot successfully.
